crossRefs.note: Then little children were brought to him, that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.
But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to…
Now, Yahweh my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know…
But Yahweh said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I…
He took a little child, and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,
“Whoever receives one such little child in my name, receives me, and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him…
